scenes.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset: one cinematic full-screen slideshow illustration for the 2D Indonesian historical game Jejak Tanah Jawa. Treat reference 1 as the identity/outfit reference of Prince Diponegoro (white turban and trailing white scarf, ivory inner tunic, charcoal-brown robe with restrained gold-brown batik edging, Javanese face). Reference 2 is ONLY the visual style: richly detailed hand-pixelled painterly story illustration with crisp pixel edges, expressive faces, layered natural scenery; do not include its fictional young couple or cat. New composition, landscape 16:9, ideally 1536x864. SCENE 01 of 8: establishing view of the Kedu Resident's house in Magelang, Java, early morning 28 March 1830. An early nineteenth century white plaster colonial residency with broad terracotta-tile roof, low verandah columns and shaded teak shutter windows; a garden courtyard, volcanic mountains softened by pale morning mist in the far distance. A few Javanese attendants approach with Diponegoro, seen from behind at a distance wearing the same white turban and dark robe. A few Dutch colonial guards stand quietly on the verandah in 1830 dark navy coats and white trousers, carrying long period flintlock muskets. Sober, tense, dignified atmosphere, cool muted teal morning light, warm earth browns, small gold highlights. Original staged historical illustration, not a copy of an existing painting. NO battle, fire, ghosts, modern rifles, modern Indonesian flags, modern objects, chains or handcuffs. Keep important heads and story action in upper 70 percent; bottom 22 percent is quieter courtyard space reserved for a future dialogue overlay. No text, letters, captions, watermark, collage, borders or UI. Exactly one coherent scene.
